root:
(?sx)
                (.+?)                # anything, followed by:
                (?:
                 (?<=\n)(?=%|\#\#) | # an eval or comment line
                 (?=\#\*) |          # multiline comment
                 (?=</?%) |          # a python block
                                     # call start or end
                 (?=\$\{) |          # a substitution
                 (?<=\n)(?=\s*%) |
                                     # - don't consume
                 (\\\n) |            # an escaped newline
                 \Z                  # end of string
                )
